title: Probabilistic soft-lease jitter for global quota resets
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem statement: When large cohorts of tenants (especially reserved-capacity customers) have aligned quota reset windows (UTC midnight, month boundary, or operator-triggered cutovers), we observe synchronized lease churn and bursty reallocation traffic to the reserved pools. This causes transient latency spikes, throttling cascades, and occasional over-commitment of burst buffers. Existing mitigations (staggered cron schedules and static per-tenant offsets) are brittle during migrations, cross-region cutovers, and daylight-saving/timezone changes.

Proposal summary: Implement a tenant-configurable probabilistic "soft-lease" reset mode that: 1) soft-expire quotas into a shadow bucket rather than an atomic reset, 2) uses a probabilistic jitter window per-tenant (configurable distribution and seed) to uniformly spread lease reacquisitions, and 3) provides a short-term microcredit smoothing token that lets tenants consume a small fraction of next-period quota immediately with amortized accounting. The design aims to reduce peak QPS on quota-manager, smooth reserved-pool allocation bursts, and preserve predictable billing by deterministic accounting reconciliation after the jitter window completes.
design_decisions: Shadow bucket: on reset, move previous-cycle remaining quota into a per-tenant shadow ledger with TTL equal to jitter_window. New-cycle quota becomes primary but consumption preferentially deducts from shadow then primary.

Probabilistic jitter: jitter sampled from configurable distribution per-tenant (default: triangular distribution biased to center of window) with a max_window configurable (default 15 minutes). Sampling is RNG-seeded by tenant-id+epoch for determinism across restarts.
Soft-lease microcredit: allow configurable microcredit percentage (default 3%) of upcoming-period quota to be used immediately; usage is amortized and visible on billing trails.
Deterministic reconciliation: after jitter window, run deterministic reconciler that reassigns leases and reconciles shadow ledger to on-chain billing ledger with audit trail for invoices.
Backward compatibility: feature flag per-org and global rollout; default OFF for reserved customers until quiet-window testing completes.
Failure modes: if reconciler fails, fall back to atomic reset and trigger rollback telemetries and alerts.
implementation_plan: Phase 1: Instrumentation and simulation harness (2 weeks) - add load test to sim reserved pool behavior under correlated resets and validate reduction in peak QPS.
Phase 2: Core quota-manager changes (3 weeks) - implement shadow bucket, probabilistic sampler, and microcredit accounting. Add feature flag and per-tenant config APIs.
Phase 3: Telemetry, dashboards, and reconciler (1 week) - add signals and reconciliation job with audit logs.
Phase 4: Canary rollout (2 weeks) - enable for internal+pilot tenants in us-west region, monitor SLOs and billing invariants.
Phase 5: Global rollout (gradual) - expand to reserved customers after acceptance criteria met.
acceptance_criteria: Simulation shows >= 85% reduction in peak quota-manager API QPS during a synthetic global reset compared to baseline
End-to-end e2e tests validate that billing ledger entries remain byte-for-byte deterministic after reconciliation for 99.9% of simulated cases
No degradation in 95th percentile latency for inference during canary window (<= 5% relative increase allowed)
Feature flag exists and per-tenant config toggles prevent accidental enablement for critical enterprise accounts
Operational playbook and rollback procedure documented and validated with on-call runbook playthrough
testing_plan: Unit tests for shadow ledger arithmetic and amortized accounting
Integration tests that run a 24h synthetic workload with DST boundary and month boundary scenarios
Chaos test: forced reconciler failures with rollback validation
Load test against staging reserved pools with 50k simulated tenants aligned to same epoch
rollout_plan: Create feature-flag gating and per-org opt-in endpoint
Enable for internal infra orgs + two pilot customers for 48 hours
Observe telemetry and billing trails; run post-mortem checklist
If stable, expand to 10% of reserved capacity and run for 7 days
Full enablement after SRE + Billing sign-off
migration_and_compatibility: New schema additive: shadow_bucket fields are optional and default to empty for older tenants
Migration job to backfill shadow_ledgers for tenants who opt into soft-lease during mid-cycle will run in bounded-rate mode
Clients and SDKs unaffected; server-side only change. API docs updated for new per-tenant reset_mode flag.
monitoring_and_alerting: Alert: quota_manager.reset_qps > baseline*2 for 5m during rollout window
Alert: billing.ledger_mismatch_count > 1 for any canary tenant
Dashboard card showing rolling-window distribution of sampled jitter offsets across tenants
Monthly report on reserved-pool peak smoothing impact and cost delta
comments: 2026-03-10 Aisha Kapoor: Created ticket after incident analysis from 2026-02-28 global cutover — observed 3x spike in reserved_pool allocation. Proposed probabilistic soft-lease to reduce stampede.
2026-03-11 Jonah Martinez: Added simulation harness plan. Initial local sim shows promising smoothing but billing reconciliation edge cases need deterministic guarantees.
2026-03-12 Design review (Priya Singh): Requested explicit deterministic seed design to ensure reconciler reproducibility across restarts. Also asked for TTL guard for shadow ledgers.
2026-03-12 Eng review (Luca Romano): Suggested triangular distribution default and recommended microcredit at 2-5% range. Flagging dependency ENG-772501 for reserved-pool backpressure hooks.
